verdicts.reason: A: the elements are scattered across the strip. The missing-asset placeholder collides with 'Saturday 21 June', the can floats on its own, and the headline is small. RSVP Free has shrunk to the same pill as the badges, so the call to action (CTA) is buried, and the legal and time text on the right is tiny. B: 'Sunset Sessions' clearly leads, and the date and time column reads well from left to right. However, the subhead is squeezed into a narrow 7-line column with awkward breaks, and RSVP is just one cell in a 2x2 grid of badges. The can and placeholder overlap the 'Reserve a spot' and legal text, the logo has almost disappeared, and the fine print is unreadable.
